description: Editorial metadata for artist pages. This file is separate from artistas/index.json, which remains the base directory of name, slug and orientative voice type.

rules.minimumIndexable: A page should only be considered for individual indexation when it contains materially differentiated, source-aware editorial value.
rules.sourcePolicy: Artist-specific factual claims require an identifiable source. Editorial observations must be presented as analysis, not biography or verified fact.
rules.equipmentPolicy: Artist-owned equipment is only stated when sourced. Otherwise equipment is labelled as an editorial recommendation.
rules.rangePolicy: Exact vocal ranges are omitted when they are estimates or disputed; classifications are contextual and orientative.

ed-sheeran.voiceClassification: Harmiq orientative classification; external analyses may place him around the tenor/light-baritone boundary.
ed-sheeran.notes: Do not publish an exact official range. Current evidence is sufficient for an analytical profile, not a fully sourced biographical dossier.

ariana-grande.voiceClassification: Harmiq database classification; contextualized with Ariana Grande's documented discussion of her naturally high voice and trained coloratura-soprano placement for Wicked.
ariana-grande.notes: Avoid presenting classical fach as a fixed medical or anatomical fact.

bad-bunny.voiceClassification: Harmiq database classification, supported contextually by a professional mastering-engineer interview describing his vocal tone as baritone.
bad-bunny.notes: Popular-music voice labels are contextual; do not treat baritone as a rigid classical fach assignment.
